name: Unified Tracker
description: Combines selected world, character, persona-stat, quest, and GM-note tracking into one structured Roleplay request that runs alongside response generation.
author: kaldigo

defaultSettings.defaultPromptTemplateDescription: One atomic structured update whose enabled sections are configured per chat.

defaultPromptTemplate: Update the enabled Unified Tracker sections from the completed conversation history supplied for this run. Preserve prior values unless the completed history changes them. Treat the appended per-chat section contracts as authoritative and return only the requested JSON object.
